title: Multilinear extension under product distributions
statement: Let $P$ be a Boolean predicate on $m$ sign inputs, let each coordinate space $A_i$ be finite with a probability mass function $p_i$, and let $a_i:A_i\to\mathbb{R}$. Form a random tuple $Y=(Y_i)_{i=1}^m$ with independent coordinates distributed according to $p_i$. The expectation of the multilinear extension of the acceptance indicator of $P$, evaluated at the vector $(a_i(Y_i))_{i=1}^m$, equals that extension evaluated at the vector of coordinate expectations $(\mathbb{E}_{p_i}[a_i])_{i=1}^m$.
